headline: Bitstamp Intake Rises To 447.0 Million Dollars As Bybit Intake Falls To 20.9 Million
narrative: The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, shows Bitstamp took in 447.0 million dollars, compared with 294.3 million dollars on the prior print, while Bybit took in 20.9 million dollars, compared with 127.3 million dollars on that print. Net inflow across venues is 514.8 million dollars, 0.1909 percent of custodied value, compared with 547.7 million dollars at 0.2022 percent on the prior print, while Binance took in 41.9 million dollars, compared with 73.7 million, and Bitfinex showed an 89.8 million dollar outflow, compared with 103.6 million. A positive print means dollars arrived where holders can sell, and a negative print means dollars left that venue.
author: jordan
